from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashPosition(BaseModel):
    """A specific cash balance figure extracted from a single company's financial statement."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company this filing belongs to")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label of the cash line item as written in the document (e.g., 'Cash', 'Cash and Cash Equivalents')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the cash balance as reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit scale of the amount (e.g., 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions', None if implied as dollars)")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the balance is as of (e.g., 'March 31, 2024')")
    verbatim_quote: str | None = Field(description="A short excerpt from the document containing the number and label")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_positions: list[CashPosition]
